children: Vietnam exported 1.45 million metric tons of coffee in the first nine months of 2026, up 16.2% from the same period a year earlier, government data showed on Saturday.
Coffee export revenues over the period fell by 7% to $6.6 billion, the Statistics Office said in a report. In September alone, the country exported 124,000 tons, up 53% annually.
